Chapter 2 · Greetings and farewells

2과 · 안녕히 계세요i-gwa · an-nyeong-hi gye-se-yo

Today we will learn to:
  • say thank you and answer,
  • choose 안녕히 가세요 or 안녕히 계세요,
  • say goodbye to a teacher and to a friend.

Practice · 읽기

대화 1 · 나비 and her teacherdae-hwa il

선생님
서나비, 이름표예요.
seo-na-bi, i-reum-pyo-ye-yo.
Seo Nabi, here is your name tag.
나비
감사합니다.
gam-sa-ham-ni-da.
Thank you.
선생님
아니에요.
a-ni-e-yo.
You’re welcome.
나비
선생님, 안녕히 계세요.
seon-saeng-nim, an-nyeong-hi gye-se-yo.
Goodbye, teacher.
선생님
잘 가요. 다음 주에 봐요.
jal ga-yo. da-eum ju-e bwa-yo.

go-ma-wo-yo!

ne, jal ga-yo!

Production · 말하기

What do you say?

Draw a card to start.

Production · 한국 문화

Bow and use two hands

In Korea, students bow to their teacher. When an adult gives you something, take it with two hands.

Try it on camera!
선생님, 안녕하세요!
seon-saeng-nim, an-nyeong-ha-se-yo! · bow
선생님, 감사합니다.
seon-saeng-nim, gam-sa-ham-ni-da. · two hands
